lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-flank, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and at least eight vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, forming a visible lattice or grid structure across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly concentrated, irregular cluster of high-intensity white pixels is present on the anterior section of the flank, immediately dorsal to the pectoral fin base, which differs from the uniform grid pattern found elsewhere.
